summary:
I thought I‘d drop you a note after all these months to tell you that finally I have made out all right, in a new environment with new people. After I flew to Canada in February I tried to start out there, renting an apartment and so forth, 
but suffered a dreadful depression, mainly due to being so lonely and far from home. After a suicide attempt I entered X-Kalay, which in Canada is like Synanon. I thrived, there; it was a tremendous experience, and going there was one of the wisest decisions of my life. Anyhow, at X-Kalay I worked my way up from the kitchen and bathroom details to doing PR work, appearing on the radio for them, etc., working to coordinate all the drug-abuse agencies in the lower B.C. area. Also I got deeply involved with the actual process of working to rehabilitate heroin addicts. Upon seeing these persons, especially the girls, many of whom as young as fifteen had had to become prostitutes, I became so anti-dope that now, half a year later, I am still thoroughly off dope and I’m sure always will be. Down here in Southern California when speaking to college classes and on the radio in a science fiction context I’ve been hammering away at the dangers of drug abuse. 

All in all I’ve become increasingly productive and busy, and really, Sam, I think my life is beginning to heal in the deepest sense possible. The wounds of the past are closing, fading out of my memory and attention. I’m living with a lovely girl who’s also a writer, although just starting ou...
